final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS sum_rental_payment_totals, AVG(rt.payment_total - oa.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals rt CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rt.payment_total > oa.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id
